description: Posts a plain-text comment on a page without editing its HTML, optionally anchored to exact visible text or as a reply (parentId, one level). Allowed on own pages, on public/unlisted pages of other users, and on private pages shared with a 'comment' grant.

exact.description: Exact visible text the comment anchors to (optional, max 2000)

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key (Idempotency-Key header). It prevents a duplicate only if outbox_capabilities lists this operation in features.idempotencyEndpoints. Omitted = generated

parentId.description: Id of the comment being replied to. Omitted = top-level comment

prefix.description: Context right before `exact`, to disambiguate repeated text

slug.description: Page slug/path; hierarchical paths are allowed (e.g. 'briefings/today')

suffix.description: Context right after `exact`, to disambiguate repeated text

name: outbox_create_comment
title: Outbox: comment or reply
